corpus.subset_rule: first --n-images samples in manifest file order

lens.fingerprint_note: sha256 over the loaded lens's fitted J_l values (x21 lens_fingerprint): equal register metrics with equal fingerprints = the same fitted lens content; different fingerprints mean the readout aliased another lens

registers.register_rule: per image position p in the image block: stickiness(p, l) = mean over the position's consecutive image-block pairs (p-1,p) and (p,p+1) of 1[top1_l == top1_l], averaged over band layers; null = permutations of the image block's top-1 values over its positions (x23 stickiness_null, per position), z(p) = mean over layers of (obs - null_mean)/null_std (layers with null spread <= 1e-12 dropped; all-spreadless positions rank by observed stickiness); registers = top --register-k positions by z (ties: observed, then lower position index)

attention.rule: one eager prefill forward with output_attentions=True per sampled image; per band layer the attention rows of the caption sources (the post-'ASSISTANT:' span of the manifest prompt+caption when the prompt prefix tokenizes as a strict prefix, else all text positions) are averaged over sources and heads, and the mass landing on each image position is correlated (Pearson, x23's helper) with that position's across-layer stickiness; the register mass ratio is mean mass at register positions / mean mass at the other image positions

probes.rule: closed-form ridge probe on the layer residual h_l (dual: w = X_tr^T (K + lambda I)^-1 y, K = X_tr X_tr^T), features standardized by TRAIN-fold moments; leave-one-image-out folds, held-out scores pooled over folds, AUC by average ranks; lambda = --probe-lambda-rel * mean train row norm^2; per position class (register / image_nonregister / text, --probe-rows-per-image rows per image, seeded subsample) and per target (object class present on the image per instances json; color word present in its ground-truth captions per captions json); targets with fewer than --probe-min-support positive images are skipped

ablation.rule: greedy captioning from the prompt-only body (the manifest sample's text minus its caption suffix; the fallback corpus's prompt verbatim) with one ResidualEdit(layer, mode='ablate', position_ids=register positions) active: mean=None zeroes the register rows at the ablate layer, mean=<corpus image-position mean residual> refills them (--ablate-mode); the edit fires only in the prefill (image positions do not recur under KV caching). Baseline = the same generation with no edits. Per condition: CHAIR-s/r vs the image's ground-truth objects, caption length (tokens/words), and the lens shift from x14 residual traces recorded post-edit at the ablate layer: per-step object-in-top-10 rate over the image's GT category emission ids, per-step binary-softmax P(yes) over the yes/no pair, and the step-0 calibrated gap z[yes] - z[no] (x18's select_yes_no_ids pair)
ablation.chair_matcher: inlined CHAIR-lite matcher (T28's matcher not committed at writing time): x13's detect_mentions (longest-first, word-boundary, (s|es) plural suffix, span masking so 'hot dog' does not also match 'dog') over the lowercased caption after a minimal noun-synonym fold (sofa->couch, motorbike->motorcycle, aeroplane->airplane, pottedplant->potted plant, diningtable->dining table, cellphone->cell phone, television->tv); CHAIR-s = fraction of captions with >=1 mention outside the image's GT objects; CHAIR-r = extra mentions / all mentions pooled (None when a condition produced no mentions). No hypernym expansion and irregular plurals are the documented gaps (as in x13)

yesno.rule: the gap uses the tokenizer ids of the capitalized leading-space forms ' Yes' / ' No' when those are single tokens — the repo's teacher-forced POPE answer form (data/pope.py appends ' ' + label.capitalize() to this same template, and generated content follows the leading-space emission convention); both ' yes'/'no' and capitalized forms are evaluated for every question word and ALL candidates are recorded; if no form is a single token (the tiny hash tokenizer), the first form of (' Yes', ' yes', 'Yes', 'yes') whose yes/no ids exist and differ supplies the FINAL subtoken id (x14's _category_token_ids convention) with single_token=false

workspace signature: registers carry the stickiness (z_img >> z_txt) while obj_reg stays ~0 (unembed-blind); trained-probe AUC at registers > 0.5 with obj_reg ~ 0 = visual state present but un-readable; attention_ratio > 1 = caption tokens attend registers preferentially

notes.mean_ablate_fill: the mean-ablate arm replaces register rows with the corpus image-position mean residual at the ablate layer (from the unedited registers pass), so 'mean' = the average image token, not the image's own mean
notes.register_transfer: register positions are identified on the corpus text (prompt+caption on the manifest) and applied to the prompt-only generation prefill; the arm asserts the image block span is identical in both
notes.lens_fingerprint: sha256 over the loaded lens's fitted J_l values (x21 lens_fingerprint): equal register metrics with equal fingerprints = the same fitted lens content; different fingerprints mean the readout aliased another lens

interpretation_limits: --n-images 20 makes every AUC/correlation a coarse estimate; the D48 band numbers (stickiness z 8-20, object rate 0-2%) come from the production 60-image x23 run, not this subset
the probe AUC compares position classes within one architecture; it does not by itself establish that registers CAUSE caption content — the ablation arm is the causal half
CHAIR-lite is an exact+synonym matcher (no hypernyms, irregular plurals a documented gap); its chair_s/r are comparable ACROSS conditions of this run, not against published CHAIR numbers
the tiny backend is a random-weight fixture: it exercises the machinery, its numbers do not transfer to the real model
